# OgreBot for EverQuest II - documentation

> The new OgreBot (in beta testing): what every window and option does, and how to move scripts written for OgreBot Classic. The website: https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/

To convert a Classic script, follow the procedure on the Converting your scripts page (Developers, below); its tool (ogre_convert.py) and data file are linked there.

## Read it all

- [Everything in one document](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-full.txt): the entire documentation, 2304 KB. If that is too much to read at once, use the smaller pieces below - together they are the same text.

## The API reference, as plain text

- [API reference for assistants](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-api.txt): every member, method, command and event, one entry each (what it does, its arguments, what it returns, an example), no tables or links. That index lists its files: everything in one, or pieces of up to 100 KB.

Each page on its own, as plain Markdown, in menu order:
